root_cause.text: The mm_struct associated with an SVA binding can be freed before iommu_sva_unbind_device() completes, because the driver did not hold a reference to the mm across the bind/unbind lifetime.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `mmgrab(client->mm)` after successful SVA bind and `mmdrop(client->mm)` after `iommu_sva_unbind_device()` in `amdxdna_client_cleanup()`, and stores the mm pointer in the client structure. The CVE description explicitly states the crash occurs due to accessing `iommu_mm` after the associated mm structure has been freed.
